title: File:American White Pelican (37030338544).jpg
desc:
A massive bird, once airborne the American white pelican is an elegant flier. Unlike their brown pelican cousins who are known for diving into the water to capture prey, these birds feed from the surface, using their beaks to scoop up fish and other aquatic organisms. This bird was captured soaring above Bear River Migratory Bird Refuge in Utah. 
Credit: Ryan Moehring / USFWS
